The NMOS CS driver gives strong gate pull-down for undershoot. Rc-Cc gives about 37 dB of DC gain for load regulation and a lower HF gain for stability across the 32x gm range. PARAMS = {
    "gmid_pass": (5.0, 3.5, 9.0),     # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX (sets W, VSG)
    "Lp":        (0.15, 0.15, 0.35),  # pass/diode L
    "N":         (20.0, 8.0, 50.0),   # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "I_tail":    (20e-6, 8e-6, 30e-6),# OTA tail current
    "I_bleed":   (20e-6, 5e-6, 30e-6),# PMOS bleed into gate node (keeps driver alive at light load)
    "gmid5":     (7.0, 4.0, 14.0),    # NMOS gate driver gm/Id at full load
    "A_hf":      (5.0, 2.5, 10.0),    # OTA high-frequency gain = gm1*Rc
    "fz":        (1.4e6, 0.3e6, 4e6), # lag zero 1/(2 pi Rc Cc)
    "L1":        (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),    # OTA input-pair L
    "gmid1":     (14.0, 8.0, 16.0),   # OTA input-pair gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    ilmin = spec.get("iload_min", 1e-4)
    ilmax = spec.get("iload_max", 1e-2)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6)
    vt = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)

    # ---- feedback divider: 10 uA ----
    idiv = 10e-6
    rtot = vt / idiv
    R2 = rtot * vref / vt
    R1 = rtot - R2
    beta = R2 / rtot

    N = p["N"]
    Ipb = 10e-6
    It = p["I_tail"]
    Ib = p["I_bleed"]

    # ---- pass device and diode (current-mirror gate drive) ----
    ipass_max = ilmax + idiv
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], p["Lp"], ipass_max, vds=0.6)
    Wd = max(mp.W / N, 0.42)
    vsg_full = mp.vgs

    # ---- NMOS gate driver M5 ----
    i5_full = ipass_max / N + Ib
    i5_min = (ilmin + idiv) / N + Ib
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], 0.15, i5_full, vds=max(vdd - vsg_full, 0.25))

    # ---- OTA ----
    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, It / 2, vds=0.6)
    gm1 = m1.gm
    Rx = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A_dc = gm1 * Rx
    Rc = p["A_hf"] / gm1
    Cc = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rc * p["fz"])

    # ---- bias ----
    mn0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    mn1 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, Ipb, vds=0.9)
    mp0 = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, Ipb, vds=1.0)
    mpt = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, It, vds=0.3)
    mpb = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, Ib, vds=0.4)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MN0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("MN1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn1)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp0)
    n.dev("MPT", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpt)
    # PMOS pair, bulk = own source (tail)
    n.dev("MP1", "nd", "vref", "tail", "tail", m1)
    n.dev("MP2", "x", "fb", "tail", "tail", m1)
    n.dev("MN3", "nd", "nd", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("MN4", "x", "nd", "vss", "vss", m3)
    # lag network at OTA output
    n.R("RC", "x", "xc", Rc)
    n.C("CC", "xc", "vss", Cc)
    # gate driver + bleed + diode + pass
    nf5 = max(1, int(round(m5.W / 10)))
    n.dev("M5", "g", "x", "vss", "vss", m5, m=nf5)
    n.dev("MPB", "g", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpb)
    nfd = max(1, int(round(Wd / 20)))
    n.M("MD", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wd, p["Lp"], m=nfd)
    nfp = min(200, max(1, int(round(mp.W / 20))))
    n.dev("MPASS", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=nfp)
    # divider
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    # ---- predictions ----
    # driver Vgs swing from min to max load (bisection on forward model)
    def vgs_at(I):
        lo, hi = 0.2, 1.3
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            try:
                r = lut.op("n", m5.W, 0.15, mid, max(vdd - vsg_full, 0.25))
                Id = r["Id"]
            except Exception:
                Id = I
            if Id > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    try:
        dvx = abs(vgs_at(i5_full) - vgs_at(i5_min))
    except Exception:
        dvx = 0.35
    load_reg = dvx / (A_dc * beta) / (ilmax - ilmin)

    gm5_min = i5_min * min(22.0, 3 * p["gmid5"])
    Gt_min = N * gm5_min
    Gt_full = N * m5.gm
    ro_full = 1.0 / mp.gds
    gm_pass_min = (ilmin + idiv) * 20.0
    ro_min = (mp.gm / mp.gds) / gm_pass_min * 1.3
    Rout_min = 1.0 / (1.0 / ro_min + 1.0 / rtot)
    T_min = A_dc * beta * Gt_min * Rout_min
    T_full = A_dc * beta * Gt_full * ro_full
    fout_min = 1 / (2 * PI * Rout_min * cl)
    T1k = min(T_min / math.sqrt(1 + (1e3 / fout_min) ** 2), T_full)
    psrr = 20 * math.log10(1 + T1k)
    line_reg = 1e3 / (1 + min(T_min, T_full))   # mV/V

    ugf_min = p["A_hf"] * beta * Gt_min / (2 * PI * cl)
    ugf_full = p["A_hf"] * beta * Gt_full / (2 * PI * cl)
    undershoot = (ilmax - ilmin) / (2 * PI * ugf_min * cl) * 0.5 + 0.02

    iq = iref + Ipb + It + Ib + (ilmin + idiv) / N + idiv
    voff = (abs(m5.vgs - m3.vgs) / A_dc) / beta
    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": 100 * voff / vt + 0.3,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": 0.002,
        "ugf_min_hz": ugf_min,
        "ugf_full_hz": ugf_full,
    }
